title: docs(skills): a bare field ref in a predicate faults, it does not read null
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xRbTTefYV6fumir4Fo1ax66)_

Fixes #30893

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates` mandates the contract-review model tier for `skills/**` (clause ①). The maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03) waives it; this PR was developed below that tier, and the dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:三个技能(`objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`、`objectstack-data`、`objectstack-ui`)不再说「谓词里裸字段引用求值为 `null`、静默隐藏或永不触发」,改为按 main 的代码逐个站点描述它的故障表现。
- 为什么改:main 上裸引用 `done` 是 `Unknown variable` 故障:`error` 校验规则、`requiredWhen` 拒绝写入并点名规则;选项 `visibleWhen` 只拒绝选了该选项的写入(表单仍提供该选项);`readonlyWhen` 字段在表单上仍可编辑,保存显示成功,服务端丢弃改动并记 warn;公式读 `null` 并记 warn;控制台里动作 `visible` 隐藏、`disabled` 置灰、字段 `visibleWhen` 照常显示,均有 console.warn。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能说明文字,无代码、schema 或行为变化;发布 `@objectstack/skills` 一个 patch;回滚即 revert。
- Token 账:合入 main(`33bc8ae5`)后 data 6068→6078、ops 3108→3106、ui 3544→3533,上限行都不动;增长由同文件删除重复句付账(见下文 Token ratchet)。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` L267-272 与 `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` L450-457;与卡片描述不同的三处见 "Deviations from the card"。
- 需要你做的:`skills/**` 是 Tier H,需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`, Verify your work: a bare field ref "faults, so an `error` validation rule refuses each write naming the rule and an action's `visible` hides it". The dashboard-binding half and the `os validate` / `os build` advice are unchanged.
- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, Verify your work: the bare ref faults; "an `error` validation rule or `requiredWhen` refuses the write naming it, an option `visibleWhen` only a write picking the option (forms still offer it); a `readonlyWhen` field stays editable and the save succeeds without its change (logged); a formula reads `null` (logged)". RLS / sharing predicates are no longer listed (see deviation 3). The form-side field `visibleWhen` is left to the ui skill, which states it.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, Verify your work: the bare ref "faults on *every* record: the action hides (`visible`) or greys out (`disabled`), the field shows; the console logs the fault". The lead-in now reads "otherwise met only at runtime" (the predicate trap is no longer silent).
- `.changeset/30893-bare-field-ref-symptom.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. No `skip-changeset`.
- Evals: `grep` of `skills/objectstack-{platform,data,ui}/evals/*.json` for null / hide / hidden / never / bare / `record.done` / fail-open/closed finds no case grading this symptom; no eval changes. `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` is untouched, as ordered.

## Each claim and the code read on `main`

| Claim | Site read |
|:--|:--|
| A bare `done` faults (`Unknown variable: done`), it does not read `null` | `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts` `buildScope` binds `record` / `previous` / `input` and namespaces only, no field flattening; the "evaluates to `null`" wording is the #1928-era comment on `firstUndeclaredReference` in `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` |
| `error` validation rule: write refused, naming the rule; `warning` / `info`: logged, write proceeds | `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` docblock "Fail-CLOSED for unevaluable predicates (#4649)", `evaluateValidationRules`; probe below |
| `requiredWhen`: write refused, naming field and rule | same file, docblock "ADR-0137 D2 — a field-rule predicate that FAULTS refuses the submit"; probe below |
| Option `visibleWhen`: only a write that picks the gated option is refused; forms keep offering the option | same file, `evaluateOptionVisibility` over `pickedGatedOptions` (only written fields, only picked values whose option carries `visibleWhen`); the docblock's D3 render side ("a faulting option predicate leaves the option offered"); probe below |
| `readonlyWhen` with a bare ref: the form keeps the field editable, the save succeeds, the server drops the change with a warning | server: same file, `isReadonlyWhenLocked` (any `unknownVariableOf(res.error)` → `return true`) and `stripReadonlyWhenFields` ("ignoring incoming change"); `packages/objectql/src/cel-fault.ts` `unknownVariableOf`; probe below. Form: `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/fieldRules.ts` `READONLY_WHEN_FAULTED = false` (ADR-0137 D3). Lint's own `readonlyWhen` fault text in `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` says the same: "the field looks writable, the save reports success, and the value silently never lands" |
| Formula field: reads `null`, warning logged once per object and field | `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts` `applyFormulaPlan` (`rec[fp.name] = null; onFault?.(…)`); `packages/objectql/src/engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts` `reportFormulaFault` (`logger.warn`) |
| Action `visible` in the console: fails CLOSED, the action hides, `console.warn` names it | `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useExpression.ts` `useCondition` with `throwOnError` (warns once, returns `false`); callers `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-group.tsx` `useMemberVisible`, `action-menu.tsx` `useMenuActionVisible`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` `useDeclaredActionShown` (objectui#11212) |
| Action `disabled`: fail-soft `true`, so the action greys out, with a console warning | `useCondition` without `throwOnError` → `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.ts` `evaluateCelCondition` fast path (`evalFieldPredicate(source, record, true, …)`); `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/fieldRules.ts` `warnPredicateFailure` (`console.warn`) |
| Field `visibleWhen` on a form: fails OPEN, the field shows, fault reported | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` `evaluateVisibility` (objectui#6443) via `isObjectFieldVisible`; `ui/packages/react/src/utils/visibilityDiagnostic.ts` `reportUnresolvableVisibilityPredicate` (`console.warn`); the render side of ADR-0137 D3 per the rule-validator docblock |
| RLS / sharing: a bare identifier is the column | `packages/formula/src/cel-to-filter.ts` `compileCelToFilter` operand case `'id'` ("Bare identifier = a single record field (RLS convention)"); `record.region` and bare `region` lower to the same column |

Probe: a throwaway vitest file in `packages/objectql/src/validation/` (deleted, not committed) against `main` printed, for `done == true` with `done` declared:

- `script`, `severity: 'error'`: `ValidationError` "Validation rule 'r1' could not be evaluated (type: Unknown variable: done) — write rejected."
- the same at `severity: 'warning'`: no throw; logged "write proceeded: the rule is advisory".
- `requiredWhen`: `ValidationError` "Field 'note' requiredWhen could not be evaluated (type: Unknown variable: done) — write rejected."
- option `visibleWhen`: `ValidationError` "Option 'b' of field 'stage' visibleWhen could not be evaluated (type: Unknown variable: done) — write rejected."
- `readonlyWhen`: warned "treating the field as LOCKED" and "Field 'amt' is read-only (readonlyWhen) — ignoring incoming change"; the payload came back `{}`.

## Deviations from the card

The order says main's code wins over the card's paraphrase; the seat accepted these before the PR.

1. **Action `visible` fails closed, not open.** The card says `evaluateVisibility` shows the control and reports. On `main` that function is the field-`visibleWhen` gate and the published export; the action renderers call `useCondition(…, { throwOnError: true })`, which hides the action and warns (objectui#11212). The skills say the action hides; only the field fails open.
2. **`readonlyWhen` with a bare ref locks, it does not refuse.** The card points at ADR-0137 D2 (refuse). A bare `done` raises `Unknown variable`, which `isReadonlyWhenLocked` takes as the #4889 unbound-root case and LOCKS: the change is ignored and logged. `@objectstack/lint`'s fault-outcome ledger (`validate-expressions.ts`) lists `readonlyWhen` as refusing; that holds for its other faults, not this one.
3. **RLS / sharing dropped from the data skill's list.** The old text named them as bare-ref traps. Their predicates are compiled to a filter by `compileCelToFilter`, where a bare name is the column, so a bare ref is not the symptom described there.

## Token ratchet

Measured with `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` on `main` at `33bc8ae5` and on this head (`main` merged in). No ratchet row moves; nothing was re-wrapped to make room. Before the merge, on `bcf8a37e0`, the data file read 6078 → 6076; #30995 has since cut it on `main`.

| File | `main` | This head | Ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 6068 | 6078 | 6078 |
| `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` | 3108 | 3106 | 3108 |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` | 3544 | 3533 | 3544 |

Deletions that pay the growth, each with its surviving home:

- `objectstack-data/SKILL.md`: "but it does **not** replace `os validate`" (after "run it too"). Home: the same sentence's "additionally checks", and `objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` Verify "(`os lint` is a *separate* style/convention pass and does not replace `os validate`.)".
- `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`: "Don't report a view/action/dashboard done until `os validate` passes." Home: the same section's opener "run the author-time gate before reporting done", and operations.md "Rule of thumb: never report a metadata change as done until `os validate` passes."
- `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (review S1/S2 commit): the Verify passage's "a form shows a `visibleWhen` field". Home: `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` Verify, "the field shows; the console logs the fault", and this file's "Use `visibleWhen` to hide irrelevant fields in ObjectUI forms".
- `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (same commit): "from any non-system write" in the `readonly: true` bullet, which restated the sentence's own subject ("A non-system write (REST/UI, …) has the field **stripped**").
- `operations.md`: the intro's "(ADR-0021)" after the dashboard clause. Home: item 3 of the same section, "**Widget-binding integrity (ADR-0021)**". The intro also drops its "ObjectStack" lead word.

**Serial.** PR #31019 also edits `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` (other lines: the `os dev` / `os validate` rows, "Both run the same gates:", the `os deploy` row) and raises that file's ratchet row. Whichever of the two lands second merges `main` and re-measures.

## Verification

Head `a7da7616`: the edit commit `87e83df5`, a merge of `origin/main` at `33bc8ae5` (no conflict, no rebase), and one commit for the contract review's two should-fixes in `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (S1 option `visibleWhen` scope, S2 `readonlyWhen` form side). `main` has moved 3 commits since, none touching `skills/**` or the ratchet script, so it was not merged again.

<details><summary>Local gates on a7da7616 (this head): 46 derived, 46 run with exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED (`dispatch-gates --ran`)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 46 commands for the 4 changed files. All ran after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a full `pnpm build` of the merged tree (exit 0), each under a 900 s timeout with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` and its exit code captured before any pipe.
- All 46 exited 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`.
- `--ran` printed: `46 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Heads `87e83df5` (pre-merge) and `99852c06` (the reviewed head) also ran all 46 with exit 0; `a7da7616` changes only `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` and the changeset text, on the same merged tree.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0 (3 commits) before each push.

</details>
